notes.text: An agent could read the application, not touch it. This release adds input over MCP.
Eight new tools, twenty-five in all — click, hover, drag, scroll, keys, text, focus, wait.
Real input, not simulated — your handlers run as for a person.
An input lane on the Timeline — every action, above what it caused.
A marker over the application — a pill naming what is happening.
No pretend success — an impossible action is refused, with the reason.
The acting tools are marked — the tool list says which ones can act.
The handshake says what is allowed — before the agent's first call.
